# Copilot Development Instructions

1. Work incrementally; implement only the current milestone.
2. Explain intended changes before implementing them.
3. Preserve existing functionality and unrelated code.
4. Use complete, functional Godot 4.x GDScript; avoid pseudocode.
5. Avoid unnecessary dependencies and keep project files in this directory.
6. Verify the project opens and runs after each milestone when Godot is available.
7. Add and run focused tests for gameplay rules before moving to the next milestone.
8. Keep gameplay logic independent from the UI; use signals between major systems where appropriate.
9. Use data-driven resources for perks, opponents, encounters, and balance values.
10. Use placeholder visuals during early development; do not create final art unless requested.
11. Do not assume purchased assets or move the project without permission.
12. Do not implement the whole game in one response. Wait for approval before starting a new milestone.
